notes: YOK-253 opt-in punish bot (Sparring Partner special-spam report 2026-11-14, F3 rec. 3b; R5, P6). Not a default anywhere: it plays only through --bot data/harness/newcomer-kihon-bot-punish.json. It is the newcomer bot with exactly one value added: fight.punish_after_block_pct 100. Each time Ryo enters blockstun on the bot's delayed screen (24 ticks late, P6), one roll; on success, on Ryo's first free tick while that screen still shows the blocked move in recovery, the bot presses his fastest move (ground normal, throw or filled special) that reaches the opponent at that screen's distance. Out of reach, nothing. It never reads the opponent's frame data: whether the punish lands is what the fight shows. 100 shows the ceiling the newcomer's reaction allows; the calibrated levels are untouched (R5). Smoke use only; no balance verdict (YOK-256).
